notes.title: Duck Demo Feedback Form
notes.content:
Hey all!

The Demo is already a few months old and we've gotten a positive response. However, we thought it'd be a good idea to get player feedback in a centralized location. So if you played the demo and want to share your thoughts with the dev team, we've complied this survey for you!

Completing this survey will help us understand more about how players are experiencing Duck and their general thoughts on it, helping us make the game better and well adjusted as we prepare to launch in 2023.

We hope that you can give us some insight into your experiences.

[url=https://forms.gle/FVmAU6jNgayTbv3s9]Take the Duck Demo Player Survey[/url]

notes.title: The Duck Demo is Released!!
notes.content:
Hey all!
Today we're releasing our playable teaser on Steam. In it you'll be able to get a general impression of the game and its mechanics. While it's certainly not final, we hope this leaves a good impression of what the full game will be like. The team put in a lot of work to make this demo happen and we hope you enjoy the fruits of our labor. Let us know your thoughts about the demo! 

If you encounter problems playing or technical issues please reach out to us at our support email: ominc.feed at gmail dot com.
